description: 1 free call per caller, then $0.0025 USDC via x402 (paid in-band: params._meta["x402/payment"]). Base or Ethereum contract address -> ABI and function list: Sourcify verification (exact/partial match), contract name, compiler, ABI, function selectors + signatures, event topics; proxies (EIP-1967, ZeppelinOS, others Sourcify detects) resolved to the implementation with its own ABI. Unverified contracts: selectors guessed from bytecode and named via the public OpenChain database. abi=false returns signatures only (smaller). When to use: Use contract-abi when an agent needs to call or decode a contract it has not seen before. Use wallet-profile for balances and account type, and token-risk to check an ERC-20 for dangerous privileges.
name: contract_abi
title: Contract ABI + Proxy Resolver
